source_facts.fact: EditRole declares an empty select#users with neither inline width nor initial option content, and initializes Select2 with multiple:true but no width option.

Bundled Select2 defaults width to resolve: it prefers inline width; otherwise it fixes the container width to the original element outerWidth. Its dropdown defaults to the container width. Placeholder search width follows the selection rendered width.

EditUserProfile already has an explicit inline width100% on select#roles and normal Select2 initialization. Existing roles are loaded as named selected options; adding a new role retains existing chips unless they are removed.
Personnel list has an ordinary Edit link to Home/EditUserProfile?userId=... for members the caller may edit. Its adjacent Options dropdown contains other actions and is not the profile editor.

diagnosis.confidence: Source-supported inference consistent with parent-measured2px/0px geometry; no live browser instrumentation or new observation by this reviewer.
diagnosis.likely_cause: The widthless empty role-member select is resolved at initialization to its small native width, then inherited by the Select2 container/dropdown; the search has no useful rendered width. The profile-role control avoids that source pattern with its pre-existing width100%.
diagnosis.not_claimed: No claim of a repaired product, traced browser layout order, server/API failure or successful member picker. No page CSS/JS injected and no app files edited.
diagnosis.future_product_fix_only: If separately authorized, a narrow explicit width on the real EditRole select/Select2 initialization can follow the existing profile pattern, with real fresh readback and compatibility verification. It is not implemented here.
